title: StockEventHistoryDto
description: A single transaction history row (issue, receive or adjustment stock event).

documentNumber.description: Generated document number of the event.

type.description: Transaction type, read from the event origin.

signature.description: Signature of the user who performed the event.

occurredDate.description: Earliest occurred date across the event's line items (ISO date).

processedDate.description: Date and time the stock event was processed (ISO date-time with zone).

entriesCount.description: Count of stock event line item entries in the event.

userId.description: Id of the user who performed the transaction.

username.description: Resolved username of the user who performed the transaction.

facilityId.description: Facility the event was recorded for. The transaction detail view resolves the cancel permission and the current stock on hand from it.

programId.description: Program the event was recorded for. The transaction detail view resolves the cancel permission and the current stock on hand from it.

reversible.description: Whether anything in the event can still be cancelled. GET /api/stockEvents/{id} reports true only when at least one line item passes every cancellation rule: it was recorded after cancelling was introduced, is an issue, a receive or an adjustment, is not a cancellation, has not been cancelled yet and has no physical inventory of the same product and lot recorded after it. GET /api/stockEvents only checks that the event has an origin and a line item that does not reverse another one, so a row in the list can be true while its event is not reversible.
